name: eshop-artillery-performance-tests
description: Artillery performance tests for EShop SUT (baseline + spike)

scripts.report:baseline: node generate-report.js reports/baseline-report.json reports/baseline-report.html "EShop Artillery — Baseline Load Test"
scripts.report:spike: node generate-report.js reports/spike-report.json reports/spike-report.html "EShop Artillery — Spike Test"
scripts.test:baseline:report: artillery run --output reports/baseline-report.json baseline.yml && npm run report:baseline
scripts.test:spike:report: artillery run --output reports/spike-report.json spike.yml && npm run report:spike
